items.anchor_event: end of each fiscal year of Guarantor
items.description: Guarantor must provide audited annual financial statements within the stated period after each fiscal year end.
items.span_text: (i) Within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of each fiscal year of Guarantor, Guarantor shall provide complete financial statements of Guarantor audited by a nationally-recognized accounting firm

items.anchor_event: end of each fiscal quarter of Guarantor
items.description: On Landlord's written request, Guarantor must provide unaudited quarterly financial statements within the stated period after each fiscal quarter end.
items.span_text: (ii) if requested in writing by Landlord, within forty-five (45) days after the end of each fiscal quarter of Guarantor, complete unaudited financial statements of the Guarantor
items.trigger: if requested in writing by Landlord

items.description: Guarantor must prepare its Financial Information under GAAP and have it certified as true and correct by a financial officer.
items.span_text: Guarantor’s Financial Information shall be prepared in accordance with GAAP and shall be certified as true and correct by a financial officer of Guarantor’s business.

items.description: Guarantor must deliver an executed estoppel certificate within the stated period after Landlord's request.
items.span_text: Guarantor shall, from time to time within fifteen (15) days after receipt of Landlord’s request, execute, acknowledge and deliver to Landlord an estoppel certificate in the form attached hereto as Exhibit A.

items.description: Guarantor must obtain and deliver a Lease L/C for Landlord's benefit in the Required L/C Amount by a deadline that is redacted.
items.span_text: On or prior to the date that is [***] after the date hereof, Guarantor shall, at Guarantor’s sole cost and expense, obtain and deliver to Landlord one Lease L/C to be issued for the benefit of Landlord, in an aggregate amount equal to [***] (the “Required L/C Amount”).

items.description: Guarantor must keep the Lease L/C in place in the Required L/C Amount throughout the Term.
items.span_text: Guarantor shall maintain the Lease L/C in the Required L/C Amount at all times during the Term.

items.anchor_event: receipt of written notice from Landlord
items.description: After a draw, Guarantor must replenish the Lease L/C to the Required L/C Amount within the stated period after Landlord's notice.
items.span_text: If Landlord draws on any Lease L/C for any reason, Guarantor shall, within thirty (30) days after receipt of written notice from Landlord, deliver to Landlord a replacement Lease L/C or an amendment to the existing Lease L/C restoring the aggregate face amount of all Lease L/C to the Required L/C Amount.
items.trigger: If Landlord draws on any Lease L/C for any reason

items.anchor_event: receipt of written notice from Landlord
items.description: If the issuer stops being an Acceptable Issuer, Guarantor must deliver a replacement Lease L/C from an Acceptable Issuer within the stated period.
items.span_text: If at any time the issuer of any Lease L/C ceases to be an Acceptable Issuer, Guarantor shall, within thirty (30) days after receipt of written notice from Landlord (or, if earlier, within five (5) Business Days prior to the stated expiration date of such Lease L/C), deliver to Landlord a replacement Lease L/C issued by an Acceptable Issuer in the Required L/C Amount.
items.trigger: If at any time the issuer of any Lease L/C ceases to be an Acceptable Issuer

items.description: Guarantor must cooperate with a transfer of the Lease L/C to a transferee of Landlord's interest, including delivering any required replacement Lease L/C.
items.span_text: Guarantor shall cooperate with such transfer, including by delivering any replacement Lease L/C that may be required in connection therewith.
items.trigger: In the event of any sale, assignment, or other transfer of Landlord’s interest in the Lease

items.description: Guarantor must pay Landlord's reasonable, documented and invoiced costs of drawing on or transferring a Lease L/C within the stated period after written demand.
items.span_text: shall be paid by Guarantor within thirty (30) days after written demand.
